title: Query network for one page
description: content-engine/queries/{slug}.json. Organised by concept and intent, never by phrase variation. The purpose is to establish topic coverage and user need — not to produce a list to insert into copy. No page is expected to answer every query in its network.

concepts.description: One entry per distinct user need. Near-identical phrasings belong inside a single concept as variants, not as separate concepts.

representative_queries.description: A few illustrative phrasings, not an exhaustive harvest.

shared_with_siblings.description: True when most sibling pages already serve this concept. A network made only of shared concepts describes a templated page.
